mapper.select: SELECT user_id, login_id, email, password, refresh_token, user_type, status, name, phone, birth_date, profile_image_url, created_at, updated_at FROM users WHERE login_id = #{loginId}
SELECT user_id, login_id, email, password, refresh_token, user_type, status, name, phone, birth_date, profile_image_url, created_at, updated_at FROM users WHERE user_id = #{userId}
SELECT user_id, login_id, email, password, refresh_token, user_type, status, name, phone, birth_date, profile_image_url, created_at, updated_at FROM users WHERE email = #{email}
SELECT user_id, login_id, email, password, refresh_token, user_type, status, name, phone, birth_date, profile_image_url, created_at, updated_at FROM users WHERE refresh_token = #{refreshToken}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO users ( login_id, email, password, user_type, name, phone, birth_date, status ) VALUES ( #{loginId}, #{email}, #{password}, #{userType}, #{name}, #{phone}, #{birthDate}, 'ACTIVE' )
mapper.update: UPDATE users SET email = #{email}, name = #{name}, phone = #{phone}, birth_date = #{birthDate}, profile_image_url = #{profileImageUrl}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE user_id = #{userId}
